answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through hardware remote attestation. Agents must operate within certified enclaves that sign actions with fused keys instead of an unverified nebula of virtual instances. This forces an attacker to incur the verifiable capital cost of dedicated silicon per identity, preventing an automated echo of bots masked behind sable proxies. However, this approach relies on centralized chip fabricators and remains vulnerable to side-channel attacks.
